# mutation-history

Install:

```
composer require rasuvaeff/mutation-history
```

## Rules

- PHP 8.3-8.5, `declare(strict_types=1)`, `final readonly class` throughout.
- Reads Infection's **per-mutant JSON log** — enable it in `infection.json5`:
  `"logs": { "json": "build/infection-log.json" }`. There is no
  `--logger-json` CLI flag; it is a config key only.
- `MutantId` identifies a mutant by `file + line + mutatorName +
  normalize(diff)`, length-prefixed so the encoding is injective — a moved
  line or a changed mutation is honestly a different mutant; the package
  never guesses "probably the same one".
- Every bucket becomes a `Datum`: `killed` and `killedByStaticAnalysis` →
  `killed`, `escaped`, `timeouted` → `timeout`, `errored` → `error`,
  `uncovered`, `ignored`. Any of those statuses is a valid `--bad-status`.
- The log is untrusted input: every field of every entry is checked, and a
  malformed one raises `InvalidArgumentException` naming the field
  (`Infection log entry escaped[3].diff must be a string`).
- Which test killed a mutant is **not** recoverable from Infection's log
  (`killedBy`/`coveredByTests` do not exist in it) — this package gives you
  trend + regression-ratchet, not per-test killing power.
- `syntaxErrors` entries are dropped — a syntax error is a tooling artifact,
  not a mutant.

## CLI

`vendor/bin/mutation-history` — the CI-facing entry point. Exit `1` on a bad
option, an unreadable log, or a failed ratchet gate; never a silent pass.

```
mutation-history digest --scope=<s> --run=<id> --log=<path> [--msi=<number>] [--storage=<dir>]
mutation-history diff   --scope=<s> --base=<run> --head=<run> [--bad-status=escaped] [--storage=<dir>]
mutation-history trend  --scope=<s> [--metric=msi] [--window=<n>] [--storage=<dir>]
mutation-history badge  --scope=<s> [--metric=msi] [--label=<text>] [--out=<path>] [--storage=<dir>]
```

- `--storage` defaults to `<cwd>/build/mutation-history`; keep that directory
  between CI runs or `diff` has no history.
- `--msi` must be numeric; `--window` must be a non-negative integer (`0`
  yields no points); an empty `--bad-status=` falls back to `escaped`.
- `diff` prints `NEW`/`OLD`/`FIXED` lines and a `newBad=… fixed=… stillBad=…
  unchanged=…` summary.
- `badge` renders `quality-ledger`'s `BadgeSvg` — a self-contained SVG, no
  shields.io and no network. Without `--out` it goes to stdout; a scope with
  no runs renders `n/a` in red and still exits `0`.
- The log is read whole — budget a `memory_limit` several times its size.

## API

```php
use Rasuvaeff\MutationHistory\InfectionLogParser;
use Rasuvaeff\MutationHistory\MutantId;
use Rasuvaeff\QualityLedger\Ledger;
use Rasuvaeff\QualityLedger\LocalFileStorage;
use Rasuvaeff\QualityLedger\RatchetGate;

$parser = new InfectionLogParser();
$ledger = new Ledger(id: new MutantId(), storage: new LocalFileStorage(__DIR__ . '/build/mutation-history'));

$json = file_get_contents('build/infection-log.json');

if ($json === false) {
    throw new RuntimeException('Could not read build/infection-log.json');
}

$report = $parser->parse(
    json: $json,
    run: getenv('GITHUB_SHA') ?: 'local',
    ts: time(),
    scope: 'acme/widgets',
    metrics: ['msi' => 91.4], // from Infection's own stats.msi, read separately
);
$ledger->append($report);

$isBad = static fn(string $status): bool => $status === 'escaped';
$diff = $ledger->diff(scope: 'acme/widgets', base: $previousSha, head: $currentSha, isBad: $isBad);
$gate = (new RatchetGate())->evaluate($diff);

if (!$gate->ok) {
    foreach ($gate->regressions as $entry) {
        printf("new escaped mutant: %s:%s (%s)\n", $entry->meta['file'], $entry->meta['line'], $entry->meta['mutator']);
    }

    exit(1);
}

$trend = $ledger->trend(scope: 'acme/widgets', metric: 'msi', window: 30);
```
